text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 9px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #f6f6f6

g.text: Takeaway: assuming 2 poles per peak gives an estimate (book: ≈ 72); the N-scan refines it — 63 (< 72) is enough — then plot, check passivity, export.

text.style: font-size: 7.9px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #a1a1a6

g.text: Plots 1–3: a toy vector fit computed for this figure (9 synthetic resonances + 10⁻⁵ noise) — illustrative, not the book’s coupler data. Amber boxes: book numbers.
